summary: Iter 216h21 (P4 Master Admin redesign) - All 6 test items PASSED. Backend endpoint GET /api/master-admin/organizations/{org_id}/integration-health works correctly with auth gating. Frontend Organisations page renders 90+ orgs with 7-tab drawer (Profile/Sites/People/Modules/Billing/Integrations/Activity). Integrations tab shows 4 rows with status pills and Manage links. People Directory with UserDetailDrawer works. Sidebar restructure verified.

test_1_integration_health_endpoint.details: GET /api/master-admin/organizations/{org_id}/integration-health returns correct JSON with stripe_connect, sicon, orbit4, sage200 blocks. Returns 401 without token, 401 with invalid token. Returns 'not configured' shapes for orgs without integration data.

test_2_organizations_list.details: AdminOrganizations renders correctly with 90 org cards. renderSection case 'organizations' properly wired.

test_3_drawer_tabs.details: All 7 tabs found with correct labels: Profile (details), Sites (sites), People (users), Modules (features), Billing (billing), Integrations (integrations), Activity (audit). data-testids: org-tab-{details|sites|users|features|billing|integrations|audit}-{org.id}

test_4_integrations_tab.details: Integrations panel renders 4 rows: Stripe Connect, Sicon Service (Sage 200 ledger), Orbit 4 (stock/equipment master), Sage 200 (customer ledger). Each row has status pill (NOT CONFIGURED). First 3 rows have Manage links. Refresh button present.

test_5_people_directory_drawer.details: People -> Directory (section=roles) loads PeopleDirectory with 101 users. Clicking user row opens UserDetailDrawer showing name, email, role, and 'Issue & copy reset link' button.

test_6_sidebar_restructure.details: 'Staff onboarding' removed from People sidebar. 'Customer onboarding' present in Organisations sidebar. AdminOnboardingHub renders with Onboard Site, Head Office (multi-site), Onboarding Packets, Bulk Imports tabs.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 216h21 P4 testing complete. All new features working: integration-health endpoint, 7-tab org drawer with Integrations tab, sidebar restructure. People Directory at section=roles, Customer onboarding at section=onboarding.
